regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Pertuzumab binds a different area of HER2 from trastuzumab. Trastuzumab binds to the HER2 protein on cells and helps reduce HER2-driven growth and recruit immune activity. HER2 testing identifies the cancers for which this approach is used.
